title: A classwise CM implication and a one-product coniveau certificate
exact_target: In a setting where the Hodge conjecture implies the Tate conjecture, must the generalized Hodge conjecture also imply the generalized Tate conjecture? In particular, does this implication hold for CM abelian varieties? The generalized assertions concern coniveau, not only individual cycle classes.
